request.input:
One small original rescue dog, compact spitz puppy with charcoal gray fur, cream muzzle and eyebrows, enormous triangular ears, amber eyes, upright curled tail. Its signature is a broad vermilion triangular rescue scarf, one end shaped like a heartbeat zigzag; a small ivory medical capsule fastened at its chest. A single cream heart-shaped patch on chest. Sitting alert with one forepaw lifted, brave friendly expression. Natural canine anatomy, four paws.

Original collectible companion creature concept for a futuristic urban extraction card game. Nonhuman pet, solo, full body.

Square composition, entire subject centered, complete ears wings tail feet and equipment within canvas, generous clean margin. Three-quarter view, plain warm off-white background, no scenery, no typography.

Coherent muted base palette with one concentrated vivid signature accent, clear grouped shadows, carefully readable face and equipment at thumbnail scale.

0.9::quasarcake::, 0.5::rella::, 0.4::gomzi::, 0.3::piromizu::

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.
